name: DCASE 2020 Task 1
description: This paper presents the details of Task 1: Acoustic Scene Classification in the DCASE 2020 Challenge. The task consists of two subtasks: classification of data from multiple devices, requiring good generalization properties, and classification using low-complexity solutions. Here we describe the datasets and baseline systems. After the challenge submission deadline, challenge results and analysis of the submissions will be added.
reputation: A standard DCASE challenge task that is widely used in the audio scene classification community and serves as a common annual benchmark.
notes: Challenge benchmark with dataset and device/domain shift issues; performance depends strongly on subtask and device generalization setting.
